items.title: Shaq and Sabonis jumping with the fans at the EuroLeague game between Zalgiris and Olympiacos. Olympiacos won 93-91 led by Evan Fournier who scored 19 PTS, while Jonas Valanciunas all-around performance with 11 PTS, 6 REB and 7 AST was not enough for Zalgiris
